verdict.rationale: Sill is a local Mac-to-iPhone/iPad screen-sharing and remote-control app with no account and no server, so it has no production dataset or service environment that a sandbox could stand in for. The story's axis does not fit this kind of product. The `--synthetic` test-pattern flag in the developer build is a development harness for the streaming host, not a sandbox environment isolating production data.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can test against a sandbox environment without touching production data
